description: Decode CSV text into a list of rows of string fields. Fields are separated by the delimiter and rows by line breaks. Empty fields between consecutive delimiters are preserved as empty strings, and a single trailing line break does not create an extra empty row. Each decoded field is reported with a neutral type tag (here always textual) and its value.

cases.expected_output:
rows=1
row[0]: str="a" | str="b" | str="" | str="" | str="c" | str="d"
